title: Beautiful tour
text: The square and the park were unbelievably beautiful.  Isabella was a terrific guide who was very knowledgable about the history of the area and also very personable.  This is a must see in Sevilla.
author: John_R

title: Spectacular history, Spectacular guide.
text: These are two spectacular, not-to-be-missed sites, with histories brought to life by Isabel, a most knowledgeable guide. I highly recommend both the tour and Isabel, a lovely, generous person.
author: RitaM_P

title: A highly skilled guide and spectacular locations
text: The Plaza de España and Maria Louisa Park are two absolutely spectacular, not-to-be-missed sites.  And Isabella is a not-to-be-missed guide as she brings history to life  with her engaging presentation.  She is thoroughly knowledgeable and could answer any question I had.  She’s kind and generous, and you will thoroughly enjoy your experience with her.
author: henfrh

title: Essential.
text: Superb experience. Despite being a Sevillian and knowing the Park, it has been a pleasure to enjoy it even more thanks to the knowledge and professionalism of our guide, Cristina.
author: 784jos_antoniog
